authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief and explicit continuation request
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded server-backed inventory purchase-entry report for the inventory-invoices Workbench route
authority.decision: Authorize reversible inventory/Procurement, Reports, API and SPA implementation plus disposable PostgreSQL/browser verification using only tenant-scoped persisted inventory_purchases headers with non-empty stored invoice_number. Expose stored purchase and receipt facts with exact twelve-field mapping and strict status/search/createdAt filters; exclude fiscal-document claims, issuance/cancellation, CFOP/tax, providers/municipality, credentials, supplier master, lot/movement reconstruction, valuation, scheduled delivery, target, production, deployment, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before treating invoice_number as a fiscal authorization/document, adding fiscal writes, tax/CFOP, supplier master, lot or movement reconstruction, commercial reconciliation, workers, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release activity.

next_action: Write and execute the intentional RED tests, then implement only the persisted purchase-entry projection and its local verification boundaries.
